title: Texas's 27th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Texas's 27th Congressional District pits incumbent Republican Michael Cloud against Democratic challenger Tanya Lloyd. The district covers a 14-county area along Texas's Gulf Coast, including parts of Corpus Christi, Victoria, and extending inland to Bastrop County. Cloud, a staunch conservative and member of the House Freedom Caucus, is seeking a fifth full term in a district rated 'Solidly Republican' by the Cook Political Report. Lloyd, a kindergarten teacher and progressive Democrat, argues for increased public education funding and healthcare access, positioning herself as a grassroots alternative in a race that has seen boundaries altered by recent mid-decade redistricting litigation.
polling_note: No district-specific opinion polls were publicly available for Texas's 27th Congressional District in 2026. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solidly Republican.'

candidates.name: Michael Cloud
candidates.summary: Michael Cloud is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Texas's 27th Congressional District, first elected in a 2018 special election. A conservative Republican and member of the House Freedom Caucus, he serves on the House Appropriations Committee and has been recognized by groups such as Heritage Action and FreedomWorks for his voting record. Prior to Congress, he chaired the Victoria County Republican Party and worked as a small business owner and media director at Faith Family Church.

candidates.name: Tanya Lloyd
candidates.summary: Tanya Lloyd is a Democratic candidate and kindergarten teacher running for U.S. House in Texas's 27th Congressional District. A fifth-generation Texan and public school educator, she campaigned on a progressive platform emphasizing public education funding, healthcare access, and economic fairness. Lloyd won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, with 63.1% of the vote against two opponents, advancing to the general election to challenge incumbent Michael Cloud.

forecast.rationale: No district-specific public polls exist for TX-27 in the 2026 cycle. The Cook Political Report rates the district 'Solidly Republican,' which is the strongest Republican rating. Incumbent Michael Cloud (R) is seeking a fifth full term and is a member of the House Freedom Caucus, indicating strong conservative alignment with the district's demonstrated partisan lean. Democratic challenger Tanya Lloyd won a three-way primary with 63.1% but has no reported polling, fundraising advantage, or other quantitative evidence of competitiveness. Recent mid-decade redistricting litigation introduces some uncertainty about boundary effects, and the complete absence of polling reduces confidence in the precise margin estimate. Nonetheless, the Cook rating, incumbency, and district history all point to an overwhelming Republican advantage consistent with the safe_r rating (95%+ GOP win probability).
